blocking: Open Item 5 - CBC (Shanna / Vu360) still owes these values.
description: Geometry-to-quantity conversion for FRP wall panels. Vu360 gives geometry only; the estimator converts by hand today.
panel_size_note: Expected as width x height in feet, e.g. 4 x 8 or 4 x 10.
waste_pct_note: Applied to panel count after coverage division.
trim_stick_length_note: Length in feet of one stick of division bar, inside corner, outside corner and cap trim.
adhesive_coverage_note: Square feet covered by one unit (pail or tube) of adhesive.
opening_handling_note: Whether door and window openings are deducted from the panel area, and above what size.
interim_behaviour: Extract and report the raw geometry - perimeter linear feet, inside corner count, outside corner count, wall height - and STOP. Emit quantities as null with status PENDING_CONSTANTS. Do not invent a panel size or a waste factor.
